figures.title: real93 LoRA training and text-to-image synthesis (arm D)
figures.notes: LoRA fitting and completed D data construction, updated 2026-10-09. Styling only inspired by supplied Jeong2026 references: bordered parallel stages, muted blue frozen weights and peach low-rank update. All scientific content derives from this project. No real93 photo is displayed. LoRA: 93 reviewed image-caption pairs; DiffSynth-Studio SFT; AdamW; FlowMatchSFTLoss; constant LR 1e-4; rank16; batch1; max pixels1048576; 93x5x4=1860 steps. LoRA base is DiT; adapters cover attention and image-MLP projections, not text encoder. The W + BA diagram is conceptual, not a claim about exact attention architecture. Generation: Qwen-Image-2.1 INT8 convrot; Qwen3VL 8B INT8; step-1860 strength0.8; Euler/simple25 steps; CFG1; random seed; denoise1;1184x896; batch1; empty negative prompt; BF16 VAE. Actual sequence: planned generation, screening, supplementary generation, screening, 1085 accepted images. No intermediate candidate counts shown. Examples D_0003,D_0159,D_0985,D_1006 are accepted dataset images. Evidence docs/v5_prompts/qwen21_lora_training_validation.md; experiments/v5_d/acceptance.md. No reference contents reused.
